jobs.heading: rear
jobs.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: ONE neutral standing direction pose for ChuaOnline. Image1 is the approved contact of this exact man for THIS heading and locks identity, face, camera elevation, scale, root and light; image2 is his neutral design reference. Same adult Vietnamese man, short dark hair, blue-grey ao lam tunic/trousers with identical seams/length, matte fabric, warm upper-left light and soft fill. Preserve input SQUARE canvas width AND height, head size/top around sourcey30, pelvis/rootx615 and ground plane aroundy1210. One1254×1254 genuinely transparent RGBA full figure with complete head, hands and feet inside margins. No mirroring, rotating the whole image, crossfade, extra figure/limb, props, floor, shadow, smoke, labels, grid, text or motion blur. Return one neutral person only.
